import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

start, end = "2025-06-01 00:00:00", "2025-07-01 00:00:00"

# Step 1: mandatory scoped counts before aggregating the traffic data
count_sql = text("""
WITH s AS (
  SELECT coordinate::geography AS geog FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14
),
r AS (
  SELECT rs.id
  FROM road_segment rs, s
  WHERE ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, s.geog, 500)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r) AS n_nearby_segments,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic t
   JOIN r ON t.road_segment_id = r.id
   WHERE t.datetime >= :start AND t.datetime < :end
     AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.datetime) IN (8,9)
     AND t.congestion_index IS NOT NULL) AS n_rush_traffic_records
""")
counts = pd.read_sql(count_sql, engine, params={"start": start, "end": end})

# Step 2: aggregate all required profile measures and assign required variables
profile_sql = text("""
WITH
s AS (
  SELECT coordinate::geography AS geog,
         ST_Buffer(coordinate::geography, 500)::geometry AS buf
  FROM air_quality_station
  WHERE id = 14
),
near_roads AS (
  SELECT rs.id
  FROM road_segment rs, s
  WHERE ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, s.geog, 500)
),
land AS (
  SELECT luz.land_category::text AS land_category,
         SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(luz.geometry, s.buf)::geography)) AS inter_area_m2
  FROM land_use_zone luz, s
  WHERE ST_Intersects(luz.geometry, s.buf)
  GROUP BY luz.land_category
  ORDER BY inter_area_m2 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND((SELECT AVG(no2)::numeric
         FROM hourly_station_air_quality
         WHERE station_id = 14
           AND datetime >= :start AND datetime < :end
           AND no2 IS NOT NULL), 1)::float AS mean_no2,
  ROUND((SELECT AVG(t.congestion_index)::numeric
         FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic t
         JOIN near_roads nr ON t.road_segment_id = nr.id
         WHERE t.datetime >= :start AND t.datetime < :end
           AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.datetime) IN (8,9)
           AND t.congestion_index IS NOT NULL), 2)::float AS rush_ci,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)::int
   FROM sensitive_area sa, s
   WHERE sa.category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
     AND ST_DWithin(ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography, s.geog, 500)) AS schools,
  (SELECT land_category FROM land) AS dom_landuse,
  (SELECT COUNT(no2)::int
   FROM hourly_station_air_quality
   WHERE station_id = 14
     AND datetime >= :start AND datetime < :end
     AND no2 IS NOT NULL) AS n_no2_records
""")
profile = pd.read_sql(profile_sql, engine, params={"start": start, "end": end}).iloc[0]

mk_no2 = float(profile["mean_no2"]) if pd.notna(profile["mean_no2"]) else None
mk_rush_ci = float(profile["rush_ci"]) if pd.notna(profile["rush_ci"]) else None
mk_schools = int(profile["schools"])
mk_dom_landuse = str(profile["dom_landuse"]) if pd.notna(profile["dom_landuse"]) else None

print({
    "n_non_null_no2_hours": int(profile["n_no2_records"]),
    "n_nearby_road_segments": int(counts.loc[0, "n_nearby_segments"]),
    "n_non_null_rush_traffic_records": int(counts.loc[0, "n_rush_traffic_records"]),
    "mk_no2": mk_no2,
    "mk_rush_ci": mk_rush_ci,
    "mk_schools": mk_schools,
    "mk_dom_landuse": mk_dom_landuse
})
